findings.title: Settings-test temp-path race NOT closed: nanosecond-unique tmp paths collide under the parallel test runner — pristine `odin test app` fails intermittently at the reviewed sha (Perkins repro: 1 fail / 30 runs; lens repro 2/10)
findings.evidence: Perkins @fe233c0: 30x pristine `odin test app` -> run 10 FAILED: 'main.settings_truncated_defaults a truncated file must fall back to defaults' with 'settings: /tmp/.../pp-settings-test-1787181903516301000 failed its checksum — defaults'. tmp_settings_path: `path := strings.concatenate({dir, "/pp-settings-test-", fmt.tprintf("%d", time.to_unix_nanoseconds(now))}, ...); os.remove(path)`. macOS clock returns the same value for back-to-back calls (~us resolution); parallel tests land on ONE path and os.remove deletes another test's fixture.
findings.detail: The r6 lens-guard demands repeated full `odin test app` runs stay green. They do not (~3-5%/run; gate 2 runs it 3x per ci-local -> ~10-15% per suite). The 16/16->18/18 green in a single run masks the flake.
findings.recommended_fix: Make paths collision-free under parallelism: per-process atomic counter and/or os.getpid in the filename (or a per-test Rng suffix). Never os.remove a path another parallel test may own.

findings.detail: S is collectible mid-drag (sel_pipe<0 during a fresh draw); the modal suppresses releases but preserves the armed drag across the cycle — a stale gesture commits late.
findings.recommended_fix: Cancel the drag (Cancel_Drag) when the panel opens, or clear drag on close.
